title: Custom Items
description: Grouped, filterable combobox results with rich options, composed from ComboboxProvider, ComboboxLabel, ComboboxInput, and ComboboxPopover, where each ComboboxItem shows an initials avatar in a ComboboxItemSlot plus a ComboboxItemLabel and a ComboboxItemDescription for the email or folder. Use it when grouped options need avatars or secondary text, or when you need the separate combobox parts instead of the single Combobox component.
